pricing_snapshot.selection: strongest general instruct models among the $0 list: largest text models first (Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, Inkling), then Gemma 4 31B and Nemotron 3 Super 120B; excluded music (Lyria), safety-classifier, code-only and sub-10B models, the openrouter/free meta-router (non-deterministic), and inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash (priced $0 today without a :free variant, so it can turn paid silently); 2026-10-11 later: thinkingmachines/inkling:free dropped (403 'only available on agentic harnesses' on the first live dispatch), google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free added as the fourth fallback; 2026-11-06: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free removed (OpenRouter answers 404 'This model is unavailable for free. The paid version is available now'), leaving 3 free models

gemini.purpose: Builder AI draft (lib/ai-draft.ts) and the free journey's read, including photos she chose to share (lib/wedding-read.ts); first step of the $0 chain, sharing the same pools and ceilings. Called only through scripts/llm/free_router.mjs.
gemini.training_note: Gemini free tier: Google may use prompts and answers to improve its products (pricing page, "Used to improve our products: Yes" on the free tier). The consent sentence says the model may keep what it is sent.

billing_probe.why: gemini-pro-latest has no free tier (pricing page: Pro paid-only). On a key with no billing it answers 429 "exceeded your current quota"; a 200 means billing is attached and every Gemini call could cost money.
billing_probe.on_200: NAMED STOP [GEMINI_BILLING_ATTACHED]: Gemini skipped for the Central day
billing_probe.cadence: once per Central day, before the first Gemini call, cached in D1 (ai_route_usage key billing|gemini|<day>)
billing_probe.checked: 2026-11-10 by the coordinator: 429 exceeded your current quota (free tier, no billing)

models.checked: 2026-11-10 200 on the free key; first because the live owner test took 22 s with gemma ahead of it (gemma stalled ~20 s, this answered in ~2 s)
2026-11-10 200 on the free key; moved last 14 Nov 2026: HTTP 500 "Internal error" or no answer on every call that day

capacity.rule: ceiling = floor(80% of the free limit), per pool (what the provider counts) per provider day and per minute. Over a ceiling the chain moves to the next step without calling. A 429 moves on at once; a daily-quota 429 marks the pool spent for its day.
capacity.gemini_finding: Read 2026-11-10: the rate-limits page no longer prints per-model free-tier numbers; it says limits are per project (not per key), RPD resets at midnight Pacific, and the active numbers are shown only in AI Studio for the signed-in project. The limits below are therefore the published-elsewhere figures marked assumed, and the code learns the real one: a daily-quota 429 marks that model spent until Pacific midnight. Confirm in AI Studio and edit rpd here; nothing else changes.

gemini:gemma-4-31b-it.rpd_basis: assumed: the Gemma free-tier figure (30 RPM, 14,400 RPD) Google printed for Gemma on the rate-limits page before limits moved to AI Studio; not printed for Gemma 4 on 2026-11-10

gemini:gemini-3.5-flash-lite.rpd_basis: assumed: Flash-Lite free tier 15 RPM / 1,000 RPD as reported in 2026 third-party guides (e.g. https://pecollective-com.pages.dev/tools/gemini-free-tier-guide/); not printed by Google on 2026-11-10

gemini:gemini-flash-latest.rpd_basis: assumed: Flash free tier measured at about 20 RPD in 2026 reports; the lowest credible figure

openrouter:free.rpd_basis: published: OpenRouter free-model limits, at least 10 credits purchased: 20 RPM, 1,000 RPD per account across all :free models, per UTC day (read 2026-11-10)
openrouter:free.shared_note: the account limit is shared with this repo scheduled jobs: 80% = 800, of which 200 are left to those jobs, so drafts stop at 600

measured.answers_per_day: about 650 to 700 free AI answers a day for the journey and the AI draft together
measured.project: Since 14 Nov 2026 the Worker secret GEMINI_API_KEY is Dream Wedding's own free-tier Google AI Studio project (no billing; vault DW_GEMINI_API_KEY), no longer the key shared with other apps, so its 1,000 a day of gemini-3.5-flash-lite and 20 a day of gemini-flash-latest are Dream Wedding's alone. The search-loop job (SEARCH_LOOP_GEMINI_API_KEY) uses the same project.
measured.how: Each model probed once with the vault key (status and Google's own 429 quota detail), plus that day's D1 ai_route_usage and wedding_reads outcomes and the Worker's WEDDING_READ log lines. gemini-3.5-flash-lite: free limit 1,000 a day per Google project, our ceiling 800, about 85% of its answers pass our checks after the 14 Nov prompt fix, so about 650 to 700 answers. gemma-4-31b-it (Gemini): published 14,400 a day but answered HTTP 500 or nothing all day, so 0 usable. gemini-flash-latest: Google's 429 says 20 a day per project (spent after one call that day, when the key's project was still shared). OpenRouter :free: 1,000 a day for the whole account, shared with other repos; Nemotron often missed the 25 s deadline and Gemma :free answered 429, so it added no answers that day.
measured.note: The sum of the pool ceilings (MODEL_CALLS_PER_DAY_GLOBAL) is a hard cap, not capacity: it counts gemma's 11,520, which gave nothing. Quote the measured figure. Repeat 'I don't know yet' answers come from the 7-day cache for no call.
